problem_statement: spacemadev/Tailstore (rebranded here as the Driftmark Supply Co. storefront) is a static, self-contained Tailwind CSS ecommerce template: hand-authored HTML pages (home, shop, single product, cart, checkout, register, 404) styled by a compiled Tailwind stylesheet, with a sticky responsive header/mega-menu, an Alpine.js mini-cart dropdown, a Swiper hero slider, and a shop product grid. Build a cross-page shopping-state continuity system on top of the store's own surfaces: (1) on the shop page, turn the product grid into a working 'The Driftmark Edit' collection filter - a category tab row (All / Women / Men / Accessories) above the six product cards, plus a live result readout that reads 'Showing N of 6 . <category>'; clicking a tab must re-render the grid to only the matching cards AND recompute the readout to the correct shown count and clicked label (for example 'Showing 3 of 6 . Women'). (2) Add a shared bag-count badge to the store header ('Bag . N') that appears on the home, shop, single-product, AND cart pages, and that increments each time a product's 'Add to Cart' button is clicked. The collection tab row and the product grid must stay inside the viewport on a 390px phone (no horizontal overflow) and lay out cleanly and legibly on tablet (834px) and desktop (1440px) - no near-white-on-white text, no overlapping or clipped product cards. Leave the cart table, checkout flow, mega-menu, mini-cart dropdown, footer, and the rest of the Tailwind store unchanged in content and structure.
required_content: The shop page shows a 'The Driftmark Edit' collection filter above the product grid with four category tabs (All, Women, Men, Accessories) and a result readout that initially reads 'Showing 6 of 6 . All Products'.

Clicking the 'Women' tab filters the grid to exactly the three Women products and updates the readout to 'Showing 3 of 6 . Women'; the click registers (the active tab changes) and the shown count and label are recomputed live, not left at a stale snapshot.
A shared bag-count badge ('Bag . N') is present in the store header on the home, shop, single-product, and cart pages and increments when an 'Add to Cart' button is clicked.

On a 390px mobile viewport the shop page has no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance: the collection tab row and the product grid wrap or reflow to fit; on 834px and 1440px they lay out cleanly with no overflow and no overlapping or clipped cards and fully legible tab and readout text.

The header, mega-menu, Alpine mini-cart dropdown, cart table with quantity steppers, order summary, checkout form, and footer remain present and unchanged in content and structure across the store's pages; no new console errors or failed network requests are introduced.
design_constraints: Preserve the Tailstore/Driftmark design language: the #ff0042 primary accent, Manrope typography, rounded cards, thin gray rules, and sticky header.

The collection filter and bag badge are additive controls on the shop grid and header; do not restructure the cart table, checkout form, mega-menu, or mini-cart dropdown, and do not rewrite product copy or remove images.

The filter behaviour and badge wiring must live in the lever's own script (assets/js/productfilter.js) and its styling in the lever's own stylesheet (assets/css/productfilter.css); do not mask mobile overflow with body/html-level overflow:hidden or by clipping content off-screen.
The lever must fit 390px mobile, 834px tablet, and 1440px desktop viewports; tabs, readout, and product cards must remain readable and non-overlapping at every size.
Keep the static Tailwind build pipeline intact - the store must still compile with the tailwindcss CLI and serve as static HTML.
state_constraints: desktop_shop captures the shop page at 1440px scrolled to 'The Driftmark Edit': the filter tab row, the readout ('Showing 6 of 6 . All Products'), the header bag badge, and the three-column product grid all lay out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_shop_filter captures the same page after clicking the Women tab: the grid shows only the three Women cards and the readout reads 'Showing 3 of 6 . Women'.
mobile_shop and tablet_shop capture the shop page at 390px and 834px: the tab row and grid reflow to fit with no horizontal overflow; with the defect they overflow the viewport.
desktop_product and desktop_cart confirm the shared bag badge is present in the header on the single-product and cart pages.

desktop_home / mobile_home / tablet_home confirm the home page (hero slider, category grid, footer) is unchanged and overflow-free; desktop_cart / desktop_checkout confirm the cart table and checkout form remain present and structurally unchanged.

change_completion: The shop page hosts a working 'The Driftmark Edit' collection filter with four tabs and a live result readout.
Clicking the Women tab filters the grid to the three Women cards and updates the readout to 'Showing 3 of 6 . Women' (no stale count or label).
The shared bag badge appears in the header on home, shop, single-product, and cart and increments on Add to Cart.
design_consistency: The filter and badge preserve the Tailstore/Driftmark identity and the shop-page layout order.
Tabs, readout, and product cards stay legible and non-overlapping; the fix does not clip or hide content to mask overflow.
responsive: At 390px the collection tab row and product grid wrap or reflow so the document width stays within the viewport.
At 834px and 1440px the filter and grid lay out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
regression: Header, mega-menu, mini-cart dropdown, cart table, summary, checkout, and footer remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

author_notes: Repo-grounded modify/state_continuity/cross_page task on the static spacemadev/Tailstore Tailwind ecommerce template (HTML + compiled Tailwind CSS, served directly, rebranded Driftmark Supply Co.). The native lever extends the shop page's own product grid into a working collection filter ('The Driftmark Edit') with a live 'Showing N of 6' readout and a shared header bag badge across home, shop, single-product, and cart. The reference wires the filter and badge correctly and lays the tab row and grid out fluidly. The seeded BAD solution ships a plausible-but-wrong patch that fails four orthogonal gates: the collection readout is written once from a stale 'Showing 6 of 6 . All Products' snapshot and never recomputed (so clicking Women filters the cards yet reports the wrong count - interaction_assertions fails while the click still succeeds); the tab row and readout render near-white on a washed-out panel and the product grid collapses into a nowrap negative-margin row so cards overlap and the last card is clipped (visual_regression fails on desktop_shop and mobile_shop via pixelmatch/ssim/block_fidelity); the tab row and grid are pinned to fixed non-wrapping widths so mobile and tablet shop overflow (no_horizontal_overflow, tolerance 24px); and the bag badge is wired only into home and shop, missing on single-product and cart (cross-page dom_assertions fail). Content and DOM copy are held identical across reference/baseline/bad; the baseline reproduces the broken layout and missing badge but keeps the correct filter wiring (so it passes interaction_assertions), giving a strict-subset failure.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: spacemadev/Tailstore is a runnable, self-contained static Tailwind ecommerce template (multi-page HTML + compiled Tailwind CSS) rebranded to Driftmark Supply Co. Its shop page already ships a product grid, and its header is shared across pages, so it natively hosts a collection filter and shared bag badge - an ideal host for a cross-page shopping-state continuity system whose discriminators are no_horizontal_overflow, visual_regression, cross-page dom_assertions, and a filter-readout interaction assertion, with content and DOM held identical across legs.
